title: Diwali Khatu Shyam Darshan
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Shubh Diwali! Khatu Shyam ji darshan

scenes.prompt: Close-up devotional darshan of the divine Sheesh (head only, no body, no flute) of Shri Khatu Shyam ji: a big divine dark face with large wide eyes and a moustache, a tall ornate golden mukut with peacock-feather and sun-ray motifs, framed in an oval of layered white, pink, blue and orange flower garlands and jewels, in a decorated sanctum, face in the middle of the frame, rows of lit clay diyas glowing around, warm Diwali evening
scenes.tts: शुभ दिवाली! खाटू श्याम जी के दर्शन कीजिए।
scenes.sub: Shubh Diwali! Khatu Shyam ji ke darshan kijiye.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly and the golden glow gently pulses

scenes.prompt: Rows of lit clay diyas and marigold garlands at the entrance of a decorated temple sanctum in the evening, warm golden light, no people
scenes.tts: दीपों की रोशनी में श्याम बाबा का दरबार सजा है।
scenes.sub: Deepon ki roshni mein Shyam Baba ka darbar saja hai.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly and a few marigold petals drift down in the warm light

scenes.prompt: Close-up of the divine Sheesh (head only, no body, no flute) of Shri Khatu Shyam ji: a big divine dark face with large wide eyes and a moustache, a tall ornate golden mukut with peacock-feather and sun-ray motifs, framed in an oval of layered white, pink, blue and orange flower garlands and jewels, in a decorated sanctum, glowing diyas in the foreground
scenes.tts: भक्त उन्हें हारे का सहारा कहकर पुकारते हैं।
scenes.sub: Bhakt unhe Haare ka Sahara kehkar pukarte hain.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya flames glow and flicker softly

scenes.prompt: A home doorway in the evening with a row of lit clay diyas, a colourful rangoli and marigold garlands, warm golden light, no people
scenes.tts: आपके घर दीप जलें, और खुशियाँ बनी रहें।
scenes.sub: Aapke ghar deep jalein, aur khushiyan bani rahein.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly and a few marigold petals drift down in the warm light

scenes.tts: कल गोवर्धन पूजा के लिए लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। जय श्री खाटू श्याम!
scenes.sub: Kal Govardhan Puja ke liye Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Jai Shree Khatu Shyam!
